messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to add APAC (Mumbai) availability notes to the Regions & data residency page. Need a short SDK snippet for Node + Python and a copy check on the residency wording. Ping @L10n for localization phrasing.

Jon Ortega: Sounds good. Can you paste the proposed SDK snippet here so I can add it to the snippet tests?

Priya Nair: Sure — draft JS + Py snippets below. Intend to show how to pick region-specific endpoints.

Priya Nair: ```js
// JS example: specify region when constructing client
const r = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'ap-south-1' });
const resp = await r.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] });
```

Priya Nair: ```py
# Python example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), region='ap-south-1')
resp = client.chat.create(model='redwood-1', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Hi'}])
```

Maya Chen: One quick note — legal link to the data residency footnote 404s on the current page (the anchor changed). I'll paste the failing link in the PR comments.

L10n Team: Thanks for looping us in. For copy we prefer "APAC (Mumbai)" in user-facing tables and keep the technical zone id in inline code. Also prefer "configured" > "purchased" for residency setup.

Priya Nair: Good call. Proposed residency sentence: "For the hosted API, requests may be routed across regions for low-latency routing and caching; customers requiring strict region residency should use Dedicated or Private deployments where data residency is configured."

Jon Ortega: Minor tweak: change "should use Dedicated or Private deployments where data residency is configured" -> "should use Dedicated or Private deployments; residency can be configured with those offerings." Otherwise lgtm. I'll add this to the docs tests.

Docs Bot: PR #4389 opened by priya — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389

Priya Nair: PTAL — CI shows a link-check failure for /legal/data-residency.md#residency-by-deployment. I'll update the anchor and add the JS/Py snippets to the region-snippets include.

Maya Chen: I'll submit a tiny patch to fix the anchor and update the example filename in the include. I can also run the local link-checker before you re-run CI.

L10n Team: :thumbsup: We'll do a quick copy pass once the anchor and phrasing edits are in. Recommend keeping the table headings short: "Region" / "Availability" / "Residency note".

Priya Nair: Plan: patch anchor + snippets in same PR, L10n review after, then merge. Thanks everyone — will tag you in PR comments when ready.

Jon Ortega: Thanks — I can follow up to add a unit test that asserts the snippet renders the region hint and the footnote link exists.

Docs Bot: CI checks queued for PR #4389 (link-check, snippet-tests)

Priya Nair: Updated PR with anchor fix and both snippets. Leaving a note in the PR for the L10n reviewers.

Maya Chen: Verified link locally, snippet include renders. No further issues from my side.

L10n Team: Approved — small wording nit fixed inline.

Priya Nair: Merging once CI green. Thanks all! :rocket:
